listening.script:
W: Excuse me, sir. You can't take pictures in this museum.
M: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't see the sign.
W: That's OK. It's next to the door.
M: I'll put my camera away right now.
listening.prompt: What will the man do next?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What will the man do next?
(聽力原文)W: Excuse me, sir. You can't take pictures in this museum.
M: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't see the sign.
W: That's OK. It's next to the door.
M: I'll put my camera away right now.
questions.explanation: 男子說「I'll put my camera away right now.」,他會把相機收起來。館內禁止拍照,所以不會繼續拍;女子已告訴他標示在門邊,他也沒說要離開。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: Why were you late for school this morning?
W: My alarm clock didn't ring, so I got up late and missed the bus.
M: Maybe you should set two alarms next time.
listening.prompt: Why was the woman late for school?

questions.stem:
【聽力】Why was the woman late for school?
(聽力原文)M: Why were you late for school this morning?
W: My alarm clock didn't ring, so I got up late and missed the bus.
M: Maybe you should set two alarms next time.
questions.explanation: 女子說「My alarm clock didn't ring」,鬧鐘沒響導致晚起、錯過公車。是她錯過公車,不是公車遲到;她也沒有生病或走路上學。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
W: I want to improve my English, but I don't know how.
M: Why not watch English movies with English subtitles? It helped me a lot.
W: That sounds fun. I'll try it tonight.
listening.prompt: What does the man suggest?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What does the man suggest?
(聽力原文)W: I want to improve my English, but I don't know how.
M: Why not watch English movies with English subtitles? It helped me a lot.
W: That sounds fun. I'll try it tonight.
questions.explanation: 男子說「Why not watch English movies with English subtitles?」,建議看有英文字幕的英文電影。上課、讀小說、跟外國朋友聊天都沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: Are we still going hiking tomorrow?
W: I'm afraid not. The weather report says a typhoon is coming.
M: Then let's go to the museum instead.
W: OK, but we should check if it will be open.
listening.prompt: What are the speakers going to do tomorrow?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What are the speakers going to do tomorrow?
(聽力原文)M: Are we still going hiking tomorrow?
W: I'm afraid not. The weather report says a typhoon is coming.
M: Then let's go to the museum instead.
W: OK, but we should check if it will be open.
options: Visit a museum if it's open.
Watch the typhoon news at home.
questions.explanation: 因為颱風要來不去爬山,男子提議改去博物館(go to the museum instead),女子同意但要先確認是否開放。爬山已取消;看颱風新聞、去海邊都沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
W: I'd like to send this package to Japan. How much will it cost?
M: It's three hundred dollars by air, or one hundred and fifty dollars by sea.
W: By sea, please. I'm not in a hurry.
listening.prompt: How much will the woman pay?

questions.stem:
【聽力】How much will the woman pay?
(聽力原文)W: I'd like to send this package to Japan. How much will it cost?
M: It's three hundred dollars by air, or one hundred and fifty dollars by sea.
W: By sea, please. I'm not in a hurry.
questions.explanation: 女子不趕時間,選擇海運(By sea, please),費用是一百五十元。三百元是空運的價錢;四百五十元是兩者相加。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Last Sunday, Tina found a wallet on the street. There was a lot of money and a student card in it. She didn't keep the money. Instead, she took the wallet to the police station. That evening, the owner, a high school boy, called Tina to thank her. He was very happy to get his wallet back.
listening.prompt: What did Tina do with the wallet?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What did Tina do with the wallet?
(聽力原文)Last Sunday, Tina found a wallet on the street. There was a lot of money and a student card in it. She didn't keep the money. Instead, she took the wallet to the police station. That evening, the owner, a high school boy, called Tina to thank her. He was very happy to get his wallet back.
options: She kept the money in it.
She left it on the street.
She gave it to her teacher.
She took it to the police station.
questions.explanation: 原文說「she took the wallet to the police station」,Tina 把錢包送到警察局。她沒有留下錢(She didn't keep the money),也沒有交給老師或留在路上。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Do you love reading? Our school library is looking for student helpers. Helpers will put books back on the shelves and help other students find books. You'll work during two lunch breaks a week. If you're interested, please sign up at the library before Friday, March fifth.
listening.prompt: What is the announcement for?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What is the announcement for?
(聽力原文)Do you love reading? Our school library is looking for student helpers. Helpers will put books back on the shelves and help other students find books. You'll work during two lunch breaks a week. If you're interested, please sign up at the library before Friday, March fifth.
options: To invite students to a reading contest.
To say the library will be closed.
To find student helpers for the library.
questions.explanation: 廣播說「Our school library is looking for student helpers.」,並說明工作內容與報名方式,目的是招募圖書館小幫手。沒有介紹新書、閉館或閱讀比賽。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Some people think students should not use phones at school. They say phones stop students from listening in class. But others believe phones can be useful. Students can look up new words or check their homework online. I think the best way is to use phones only when teachers say it's OK.
listening.prompt: What does the speaker think about phones at school?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What does the speaker think about phones at school?
(聽力原文)Some people think students should not use phones at school. They say phones stop students from listening in class. But others believe phones can be useful. Students can look up new words or check their homework online. I think the best way is to use phones only when teachers say it's OK.
options: Students should never bring them to school.
Phones aren't useful for students at all.
Students should use them any time they want.
Students should use them only when teachers allow it.
questions.explanation: 說話者最後說「I think the best way is to use phones only when teachers say it's OK.」,認為只在老師允許時使用。說話者並不贊成完全禁止,也不贊成隨時使用;他也提到手機可以查單字,所以不是沒有用。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Hello. This is Sunshine Dental Clinic calling for David Lin. Your appointment has been moved from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning at ten. If this time isn't good for you, please call us back before five o'clock today. Thank you, and have a nice day.
listening.prompt: When is David's new appointment?

questions.stem:
【聽力】When is David's new appointment?
(聽力原文)Hello. This is Sunshine Dental Clinic calling for David Lin. Your appointment has been moved from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning at ten. If this time isn't good for you, please call us back before five o'clock today. Thank you, and have a nice day.
options: On Thursday at ten in the morning.
On Friday at ten in the morning.
On Friday at five in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 留言說預約「moved from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning at ten」,新時間是星期五早上十點。星期四下午是原本的時間;五點是今天回電的期限。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Every year, people throw away millions of plastic bottles. Many of them end up in the ocean and hurt sea animals. We can help by carrying our own water bottles and saying no to plastic straws. Small changes in our daily lives can make a big difference to the Earth.
listening.prompt: What is the main idea of the talk?

questions.stem:
【聽力】What is the main idea of the talk?
(聽力原文)Every year, people throw away millions of plastic bottles. Many of them end up in the ocean and hurt sea animals. We can help by carrying our own water bottles and saying no to plastic straws. Small changes in our daily lives can make a big difference to the Earth.
options: We should learn how plastic bottles are made.
Sea animals are dangerous to people.
We should buy more bottled water.
We should use less plastic to protect the Earth.
questions.explanation: 短文說明塑膠瓶傷害海洋動物,建議自備水瓶、不用塑膠吸管,主旨是減少使用塑膠來保護地球。文中沒有說明塑膠瓶如何製造;受傷害的是海洋動物,不是動物危害人類;買更多瓶裝水正好相反。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Your brother looks tired every morning.
B: Yes. He ___ to bed very late, and he ___ always busy with his homework.
questions.explanation: 主詞 He 是第三人稱單數,第一格是一般動詞「上床睡覺」,要加 -es 寫成 goes;第二格後面接形容詞 busy,要用 be 動詞 is。go 沒有配合第三人稱單數;does busy 把助動詞誤當 be 動詞;is go 是 be 動詞和原形動詞並用,都是錯的。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My parents ___ like spicy food, but my sister ___. She eats spicy hot pot almost every week.
questions.explanation: 主詞 My parents 是複數,否定一般動詞 like 用 don't;後半句由 but 和「每週吃火鍋」可知姊姊喜歡辣,省略重複的 like,單數主詞用 does 代替。doesn't 不能配複數主詞;do 不能配單數 my sister;aren't / is 是 be 動詞,不能代替一般動詞 like。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Neither Amy nor her classmates ___ interested in the new club, but each of them ___ a different reason.
questions.explanation: neither A nor B 當主詞時,動詞跟最靠近的 B 一致,her classmates 是複數,所以用 are;each of them 意思是「他們每一個」,視為單數,動詞用 has。is 是把 Amy 當主詞;have 是把 each of them 誤當複數。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Is this water bottle ___?
B: No, it isn't. Mine has a cat on it. Maybe it's Ken's. He always leaves ___ things in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 第一格後面沒有名詞,要用所有格代名詞 yours(= your water bottle);第二格後接名詞 things,要用所有格形容詞 his。your 後面必須接名詞;him 是受格、he's 是 he is 的縮寫,都不能放在名詞前表示「他的」。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Tina and I made the chocolate cake by ___. Everyone at the party said ___ was the best dessert of the night.
questions.explanation: 主詞 Tina and I 是「我們」,by oneself 要用反身代名詞 ourselves;第二格指那一個蛋糕,當子句主詞用 it。myself 只指我一個人;its 是所有格,不能當主詞;us 是受格,不表示「靠自己」,they 也與單數的蛋糕不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My pencil case is too old, so I'm going to buy a new ___. My sister needs some markers, so I'll get ___ for her, too.
questions.explanation: 「買一個新的」是同類但不是同一個東西,用 one 代替 pencil case;第二格指不特定的幾支麥克筆,用 some。a new it 不合文法;it 不能指複數的 markers;ones 前面需有形容詞或冠詞修飾,而且 a new it 本身就錯。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
There ___ only a little ___ left in the bottle, so we need to buy more before the party.
questions.explanation: a little 修飾不可數名詞,juice 在此為不可數,不加 s;不可數名詞當主詞時 There 後面用 is。juices 加了 s 與 a little 不合;are 是配複數名詞的。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My uncle is ___ honest man. He teaches at ___ university in Tainan, and ___ students there all like him.
questions.explanation: 冠詞看「發音」不看字母:honest 的 h 不發音,以母音開頭,用 an;university 發音以 /j/ 子音開頭,用 a;最後指「那所大學的」學生,是特定的,用 the。誤以為 h 一定是子音而用 a,或看到 u 就用 an,都是常見錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Mom asked me to buy two ___ of bread and a dozen ___ for breakfast tomorrow.
questions.explanation: bread 不可數,要用單位 loaf 計算,兩條是 two loaves(f 改 ves);a dozen(一打)後面接複數可數名詞 eggs。loafs 拼法錯;loaf 沒有隨 two 變複數;egg 沒有配合 a dozen 用複數。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Can I talk to Jack?
B: Sorry, he ___ a shower right now. He always ___ a shower after he plays basketball.
questions.explanation: 第一句有 right now,表示此刻正在做,用現在進行式 is taking;第二句有 always 和「每次打完球之後」,描述習慣,用現在簡單式 takes。兩格時態對調或用同一種時態,都沒有分清「正在發生」與「習慣」。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Listen! Someone ___ the piano upstairs. The music ___ really beautiful.
questions.explanation: Listen! 表示此刻正在彈,用 is playing;sound(聽起來)是感官連綴動詞,表示狀態,通常不用進行式,用 sounds。plays 沒表現出「正在」;is sounding 把狀態動詞誤用進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Look at the sky. The sun ___, and the birds ___ back to their nests. It's getting dark.
questions.explanation: Look 表示眼前正在發生，兩格都用現在進行式；the birds 是複數用 are flying。set 是單音節字，以「短母音 + 單一子音」結尾，加 -ing 要重複 t 寫成 setting。sets / fly 是簡單式；is flying 與複數主詞不合；seting 拼法錯誤。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: ___ do you go to the library?
B: Twice a week. I usually go there on Tuesdays and Fridays.
questions.explanation: 回答的重點是 Twice a week(一週兩次),問的是頻率,用 How often。How long 問多久(時間長度);When 問什麼時候,回答應先說時間點;How soon 問「多快、多久之後」,都與回答不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: ___ did you buy for your mom's birthday?
B: A scarf.
A: ___ did you pay for it?
B: Five hundred dollars.
questions.explanation: 第一個回答是「一條圍巾」,問買了什麼東西用 What;第二個回答是價錢,問付了多少錢用 How much。How many 問可數名詞的數量,不問價錢;How did you buy 問的是方式,與「一條圍巾」不合;Which 用在有限選項中挑選,且第二格也錯。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: ___ bike is this? It's in front of my door.
B: It's Mr. Lin's. He ___ next door.
questions.explanation: 空格後接名詞 bike,回答是 Mr. Lin's(林先生的),問「誰的」用 Whose;He 是第三人稱單數,現在簡單式用 lives。Who's 是 Who is 的縮寫,後面不能直接接 bike is;Who 不能修飾名詞;live 沒有配合第三人稱單數。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Look! The lights in Tom's room are on. He ___ be at home.
B: No, he ___ be at home. I saw him at the park five minutes ago.
questions.explanation: A 由燈亮著做出肯定的推測「他一定在家」,用 must;B 剛在公園看到他,做出否定推測「他不可能在家」,用 can't。mustn't 表示「禁止」,不是「不可能」;can't / must 與兩人的推理方向相反;should 表示「應該」,不是推測。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Mom, ___ I go out and play basketball now?
B: No, you ___. You ___ finish your homework first. It's due tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 孩子請求許可,用 Can I…?;媽媽拒絕,簡答用 No, you can't;作業明天要交,所以「必須先完成」,用 must。must I 問的是「我是否必須」,不是請求;第三格用 can 只表示「可以」,沒有表達必須先寫完作業;don't 不能回答 should 的問句。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
You ___ eat or drink anything in the computer room. It's against the rules. But you ___ bring your own water bottle and leave it outside the door.
questions.explanation: 違反規定代表「禁止」,用 mustn't;後面 But 轉折,表示「可以」把水壺帶來放在門外,用 can。don't have to 是「不必」,不是禁止;第二格用 mustn't 或 can't 與 But 的語氣矛盾;should 與「違規」意思相反。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Don't forget to call me when you get to Japan.
B: OK. I ___ you as soon as I ___ in Tokyo.
questions.explanation: 主要子句說的是未來的事,用 will call;as soon as 引導的時間副詞子句,要用現在簡單式代替未來式,所以用 arrive。時間子句裡用 will arrive 是常見錯誤;called 是過去式,與「還沒到日本」不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: What if the weather is bad tomorrow?
B: If it ___ tomorrow, we ___ the picnic to next Sunday.
questions.explanation: if 引導的條件子句,以現在簡單式代替未來式,用 rains;主要子句說明未來會怎麼做,用 will move。條件子句裡用 will rain 不正確;rained / move 時態與「明天」不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain soon. Let's go home before it ___.
questions.explanation: 看到烏雲,依眼前跡象推測即將下雨,用 is going to;before 引導時間子句,要用現在簡單式代替未來式,用 starts。時間子句裡的 will start 錯誤;was going to / started 是過去式,與 Look 的當下情境不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Taipei 101 was once taller than ___ building in the world.
questions.explanation: 台北 101 本身也是建築物,和其他建築比較時要排除自己,用 any other + 單數名詞,意思等於最高級。any building 包含了自己,邏輯不通;all the other 後面要接複數 buildings;the other building 指兩者中的另一棟,不合語意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Both dictionaries are good. This one is ___ that one, but that one costs only two hundred dollars, so it is much ___.
questions.explanation: Both… are good 表示兩本一樣好用,用 as useful as;後半句說那本只要兩百元,much 修飾比較級,cheap 是單音節,比較級是 cheaper。more cheap 形式錯誤;more useful 缺少 than;useful than 缺少 more,much 後也不能接最高級 cheapest。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My English teacher always says, "The ___ you read, the ___ your English will become."
questions.explanation: 「越……就越……」的句型是 the + 比較級, the + 比較級。read 越多用 more;become 後接形容詞,good 的比較級是 better。most / best 是最高級;much / good 是原級;well 是副詞原級,也不是比較級。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
When I ___ home yesterday evening, my sister ___ dinner in the kitchen, so the whole house smelled good.
questions.explanation: yesterday evening 是過去時間,「我到家」是短暫動作用過去式 got;「姊姊正在煮飯」是當時進行中的動作,用過去進行式 was cooking。get / cooks 是現在式;is cooking 與 yesterday 不合;was getting / cooked 把短暫與持續動作的時態弄反了。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: ___ you see the new movie last night?
B: No, I ___. I ___ too tired, so I went to bed early.
questions.explanation: see 是一般動詞,過去式問句用 Did,簡答 No, I didn't;第三格後接形容詞 tired,主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。Were you see 混用了 be 動詞與一般動詞;I were 主詞動詞不一致;Do / don't / am 是現在式,與 last night 不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My grandfather ___ in Hualien for twenty years. Then he ___ to Taipei in 2010, and he still lives there now.
questions.explanation: 住在花蓮二十年是已經結束的過去經歷(後來搬走了),用過去式 lived;in 2010 是明確的過去時間,用過去式 moved。has lived 表示到現在還住花蓮,與「現在住台北」矛盾;明確的過去時間點不能用現在完成式 has moved;lives 是現在式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
___ it rained heavily all afternoon, the baseball game was not canceled.
questions.explanation: 前後句意相反(下大雨,比賽卻沒取消),要用表示讓步的連接詞 Although。Because 表因果,語意不合;Because of 和 Despite 都是介系詞,後面要接名詞,不能接完整子句 it rained…。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
It's already seven forty. Hurry up, ___ you will miss the school bus.
questions.explanation: 祈使句 + or 表示「否則」:快一點,否則會錯過校車。祈使句 + and 是「這樣做就會……」,變成「快一點就會錯過校車」,語意相反;but 表轉折、so 表結果,都不合句意。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My little brother was born ___ the morning ___ May 5, 2015.
questions.explanation: 單說 in the morning 用 in,但「某一天的早上」指特定日期,要用 on the morning of + 日期。只記得 in the morning 而選 in 是常見陷阱;at 用於時間點;May 5 前雖用 on,但此處要用 of 連接 the morning 與日期。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
We stayed at home ___ the typhoon. ___ the typhoon was coming, all the schools in the city were closed.
questions.explanation: 第一格後面接名詞片語 the typhoon,用介系詞 because of;第二格後面是完整子句 the typhoon was coming,用連接詞 Because。because 後不能只接名詞;Because of 後不能接子句;Though 表讓步,與「颱風要來所以停課」的因果關係不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
I'm so sorry. I forgot ___ the door when I left this morning, so your cat ran out of the house.
questions.explanation: forget to V 是「忘了去做(沒做)」,forget V-ing 是「忘了做過(其實做了)」。貓跑出去,表示門根本沒鎖,所以用 to lock。locking 表示「忘記自己鎖過門」,與結果矛盾;forgot 後不能直接接原形 lock 或過去式 locked。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Mr. Wang felt very sleepy on his way to work, so he stopped at a store ___ a cup of coffee.
questions.explanation: 他很想睡,所以中途停下來「為了買」咖啡,這裡的不定詞 to buy 表示目的。stop V-ing 是「停止做某事」,stopped at a store buying 不能表達目的;buy、bought 不能直接接在此處。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
My doctor told me to give up ___ junk food. She also suggested ___ more fruit and vegetables every day.
questions.explanation: give up(放棄)是片語動詞,up 為副詞,後接動名詞 eating;suggest(建議)後面也接動名詞,不接不定詞,所以兩格都是 eating。學生常因 told me to 而誤以為後面也用不定詞,或以為 suggest 後可接 to V。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
It's hard for me ___ up early on weekends because I'm not used to ___ up before eight.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V 是虛主詞句型,用 to get;be used to(習慣於)的 to 是介系詞,後面接動名詞 getting。把 be used to 的 to 當成不定詞而接原形 get,是常見錯誤;It's hard for me getting / get 也不合句型。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Where's Ben? I need his help.
B: He ___ to the post office. He'll be back in ten minutes.
questions.explanation: Ben 現在不在這裡、等一下才回來,表示「已經去了(人還在那裡)」,用 has gone to。has been to 是「曾經去過(已經回來)」,與人不在不合;went 是過去式,不能接在 has 後面;goes 表示習慣,不合情境。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
I ___ this phone for three years. My father ___ it for me when I entered junior high school.
questions.explanation: for three years 表示從過去持續到現在,要用持續性動詞 have had;第二句有明確過去時間 when I entered…,用過去式 bought。buy 是瞬間動詞,不能和 for three years 連用;明確過去時間不能用現在完成式 have bought。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
It ___ ten years since we last ___ each other. You look so different now!
questions.explanation: 「自從……以來已經十年」用 It has been + 時間 + since + 過去式;since 後面是過去某時發生的動作(上次見面),用 saw。since 子句不用現在完成式 have seen;was / is 不能表達一直延續到現在的時間。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Have you finished your science report ___?
B: Yes, I've ___ finished it. I handed it in this morning.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式的疑問句問「已經……了嗎」用 yet,放句尾;肯定句表示「已經」用 already,放在 have 和過去分詞中間。yet 不用於這種肯定句;ever 表示「曾經」,不能說 I've ever finished it。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
This temple ___ more than two hundred years ago, and today it ___ by thousands of tourists every year.
questions.explanation: 寺廟是「被建造」,而且是兩百多年前,用過去式被動 was built;today 和 every year 表示現在的常態,寺廟「被參觀」,用現在式被動 is visited。built / visits 是主動語態,主詞寺廟不能自己建造或參觀;另兩組時態與時間副詞不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Look! The windows in our classroom ___ clean and shiny now. They ___ by the students this morning.
questions.explanation: 第一句 clean 是形容詞,描述現在的狀態,複數主詞用 are;第二句窗戶是「被學生擦」,this morning 是過去,用過去式被動 were cleaned。cleaned 單獨使用變成窗戶自己擦了東西;were / are cleaned 時態顛倒;is 與複數不合,were cleaning 是主動進行式。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Why are you walking to school today? Where's your bike?
B: It ___ last night. The police are looking for it now.
questions.explanation: 腳踏車是「被偷」,last night 是過去時間,用過去式被動 was stolen。stole、has stolen、was stealing 都是主動語態,變成「腳踏車偷了東西」,語意錯誤;而且 has stolen 也不能和 last night 連用。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Sorry, the cheesecake can't ___ now. It needs to stay in the fridge for two more hours.
questions.explanation: 蛋糕是「被吃」,助動詞後面的被動語態是 can't + be + 過去分詞,所以用 be eaten。eat 變成蛋糕自己吃東西;be eating 是進行式;助動詞後面不能直接接過去分詞 eaten。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
A: Excuse me. Could you tell me ___? I want to take the train to Kaohsiung.
B: Sure. Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
options: where does the train station is
questions.explanation: 間接問句放在 Could you tell me 後面當受詞,要用直述句語序「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」,所以是 where the train station is。where is the train station 保留了疑問句倒裝;does 不能代替 be 動詞 is;where does … is 同時誤用助動詞與 be 動詞。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Lucy hasn't decided yet, so I really don't know ___ to the party tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「不知道她是否會來」用 if(或 whether)引導間接問句,語序為直述句;此 if 子句是名詞子句(當 know 的受詞),談論明天的事可用 will,所以是 if she will come。will she come 與 whether does she come 都保留了倒裝語序;that 不能表示「是否」。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
Your brother has never been to Japan, ___? He talks about Tokyo all the time.
questions.explanation: 附加問句跟著前句的助動詞 has;前句有否定詞 never,已經是否定句,附加問句要用肯定形,所以是 has he。hasn't he 忽略了 never 的否定意思;does / doesn't 與前句的現在完成式不合。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
The girl ___ is talking to our teacher is the new student ___ moved here from Canada last week.
questions.explanation: 兩個空格的先行詞都是「人」(the girl、the new student),而且在子句中當主詞,都用 who。which 只能指事物;whose 後面要接名詞,表示所有關係,這裡後面接動詞 is talking。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
This is the old house ___ roof was badly damaged by the typhoon last summer.
questions.explanation: 空格後面是名詞 roof，「這棟房子的屋頂」表示所有關係，用 whose；whose 的先行詞可以是人也可以是物。which、that 不能直接接名詞表示「它的……」，放在這裡句子不成立；who 只能指人，也不表示所有關係。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
The storybook ___ I borrowed from you last week ___ very interesting. I couldn't stop reading it.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 the storybook 是物,在子句中當 borrowed 的受詞,可用 that(或 which);整句主詞是單數的 the storybook,動詞用 is。who 只指人;are 誤把 you 或 I 當成主詞;what 本身已含先行詞,不能接在名詞後面。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
選出最適合填入空格的答案。
I have a friend ___ dream is to become a pilot, and he likes reading books ___ are about airplanes.
questions.explanation: 第一格後接名詞 dream,表示「這位朋友的夢想」,用 whose;第二格先行詞 books 是物,在子句中當主詞,用 that(或 which)。who dream 缺少所有格的意思;who 不能指 books;which 不能指人,whose are 後面也缺名詞。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: What day is it today?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)What day is it today?
questions.explanation: 「What day is it today?」問今天星期幾，應回答「It's Wednesday.」。回答天氣、時間或物品主人都沒有回答星期幾。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Nice to meet you.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Nice to meet you.
questions.explanation: 初次見面說「Nice to meet you.」，回應應為「Nice to meet you, too.」。「I'm fine, thanks.」是回答問候近況；「See you again next week.」用於道別；「You're welcome.」用於回應道謝。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: How much is this pen?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)How much is this pen?
questions.explanation: 「How much」問價錢，應回答「It's thirty dollars.」。筆的顏色、位置或自己有幾支筆都沒有回答價錢。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Happy birthday, Amy!
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Happy birthday, Amy!
questions.explanation: 別人祝你生日快樂，應道謝回答「Thank you so much.」。「That's all right.」用來回應道歉；「Yes, it is.」與「Good idea.」都不是對祝福的回應。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: What color is your new bike?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)What color is your new bike?
questions.explanation: 「What color」問顏色，應回答「It's red.」。說它是新的、每天騎或兩年了，都沒有回答顏色；何況題目已說是新腳踏車，「兩年了」也不合理。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: May I take your order?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)May I take your order?
options: No, I don't want to take it home.
Yes, I'd like a hamburger, please.
Yes, the order is very big and heavy.
questions.explanation: 「May I take your order?」是店員詢問要點什麼餐，應回答想點的餐點「I'd like a hamburger, please.」。其他回應誤把 take 當成「拿走」，或把 order 當成一般名詞，都不合語境。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I'm sorry I'm late.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)I'm sorry I'm late.
options: That's all right. Please sit down.
You're welcome. Have a nice day.
Sorry, I don't know the way to school.
questions.explanation: 對方為遲到道歉，應表示沒關係「That's all right.」並請他坐下。「You're welcome.」用來回應道謝；「Yes, please. I'd love to.」用來接受邀請；說自己不知道路與遲到道歉無關。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: What does your father do?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)What does your father do?
questions.explanation: 「What does your father do?」問父親的職業，應回答「He's a bus driver.」。「He's watching TV.」回答的是「現在正在做什麼」；身高體型是外表；「He does it every day.」沒有回答問題。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: How was your trip to Kenting?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)How was your trip to Kenting?
options: It was wonderful. We swam every day.
It's in the south of Taiwan, near the sea.
questions.explanation: 「How was your trip?」問旅行感想，應回答「It was wonderful.」並補充內容。搭什麼交通工具、下週才要去（與已去過矛盾）、墾丁的位置，都沒有回答旅行如何。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Can I help you?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Can I help you?
options: Sure. What can I do for you?
questions.explanation: 店員問「Can I help you?」，顧客應說明需求「I need a jacket.」。「What can I do for you?」是店員的說法，角色顛倒；「I can't do it.」與「I can swim.」都誤解成問自己的能力。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Let's go swimming this afternoon.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Let's go swimming this afternoon.
options: Yes, I swam very well last summer.
Sorry, it's not my swimsuit. It's Amy's.
Sounds great. What time shall we meet?
questions.explanation: 對方提議下午去游泳，接受提議並詢問碰面時間最適當。「I swam very well.」講的是過去游得好；「I'm full.」用於婉拒食物；泳衣不是自己的與提議無關。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Would you like some more cake?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Would you like some more cake?
options: Yes, it's chocolate cake with cream.
questions.explanation: 「Would you like some more cake?」是問要不要再吃一些蛋糕，婉拒時說「No, thanks. I've had enough.」。說蛋糕的口味、不是自己做的或「是昨天」都沒有回應要不要再吃。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Which bus goes to the train station?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Which bus goes to the train station?
questions.explanation: 「Which bus」問哪一路公車到火車站，應回答「Take Bus 22.」。花多少時間、公車很擠、自己搭公車去，都沒有說出是哪一路公車。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Could you turn down the music? I'm studying.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Could you turn down the music? I'm studying.
options: Sure, the music is great, isn't it?
Oh, sorry. I'll turn it down now.
questions.explanation: 對方請你把音樂關小聲，因為他在讀書，應道歉並照做。說自己也在讀書、稱讚音樂好聽，或誤以為在問是否讀音樂，都沒有回應這個請求。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Hello. May I speak to Mr. Wang?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Hello. May I speak to Mr. Wang?
options: Sorry, he's not in right now.
questions.explanation: 電話中「May I speak to Mr. Wang?」是要找王先生，回答「Sorry, he's not in right now.」表示他不在最適當。「I'm speaking English.」誤解 speak 的意思；「I'm fine」是回答問候；「he can't speak」誤以為在問他能不能說話。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Excuse me. Is anyone sitting here?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Excuse me. Is anyone sitting here?
options: No. Go ahead and take it.
questions.explanation: 問「Is anyone sitting here?」（這裡有人坐嗎？），座位沒人時答「No」，再請對方坐下。「Yes. Please have a seat.」前後矛盾：說有人坐卻又請對方坐；「I'm not tired」答非所問；「Yes, it's a comfortable seat.」說有人坐，卻只評論椅子舒適，沒有回應對方想坐的需求。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I didn't sleep well last night.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)I didn't sleep well last night.
options: Maybe you should go to bed early tonight.
Good for you. Keep it up.
It's nice of you to say so.
I'm glad you slept well. You look great.
questions.explanation: 對方說昨晚沒睡好，建議他今晚早點睡最適當。「Good for you. Keep it up.」是稱讚好表現；「It's nice of you to say so.」回應讚美；「I'm glad you slept well.」誤解成睡得好。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: You haven't finished your homework yet, have you?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)You haven't finished your homework yet, have you?
options: No, I handed it in this morning.
No, I'm still working on it.
questions.explanation: 附加問句的回答看事實：沒寫完答 No，寫完答 Yes。「No, I'm still working on it.」表示還沒寫完、正在寫，前後一致。「Yes, I haven't started yet.」與「Yes, I'll start it soon.」中 Yes 代表已寫完，卻又說還沒開始；「No, I handed it in」中 No 代表沒寫完，卻又說已交出，都自相矛盾。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I can't believe I left my wallet on the bus!
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)I can't believe I left my wallet on the bus!
options: Congratulations! You must be very happy.
Why don't you call the bus company right away?

During the summer, students can borrow up to ten books at a time, not five as usual. Books can be kept for three weeks.

Every Saturday afternoon, there will be a free storytelling hour for children in Room 201. No sign-up is needed. Just come and enjoy!

The study room on the third floor will be closed in July because the old desks and chairs will be replaced. It will open again on August 1.

For more information, call 02-2345-6789 or visit our website.

options: On a Monday afternoon in August.

On a Sunday evening in July.
questions.explanation: 要同時符合兩個條件：自習室 7 月整修、8 月才開放，而且圖書館週一休館。8 月的週二上午符合條件。8 月的週一休館；7 月的兩個時段自習室都還沒開放。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
From: Emma Brown
To: Lin Mei-hua
Subject: My first month in Taiwan

Dear Mei-hua,

How are you? It's been a month since I came to Taiwan as an exchange student, and I'm enjoying my life here.

My host family is very kind. Every weekend, they take me to different places. Last Sunday, we went to Jiufen. The old street was crowded, but the view of the sea was amazing.

School is a little hard for me. My classmates speak Chinese so fast that I often miss what they say. Luckily, my classmate Ivy sits next to me and helps me take notes. In return, I help her practice English after class.

I miss my family in Canada, but I'm too busy to feel lonely. Next month, my host family will take me to a barbecue for the Moon Festival. I can't wait!

Please write back and tell me about your new school.

Love,
Emma

Why did Emma write this email?

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
When people think of heroes, they often picture firefighters or doctors. But for the people of a small town in Pingtung, a hero can also be a fourteen-year-old boy.

Two years ago, Chen Yu-jie noticed that many old people in his town ate dinner alone. Their children worked in big cities and seldom came home. So Yu-jie started a plan called "Dinner with Grandpa and Grandma." Every Friday evening, he and his classmates cooked simple meals at the community center and invited the old people to eat with them.

At first, only five people came. Some old people were shy, and some didn't believe the students would keep doing it. But Yu-jie never gave up. He visited them one by one and listened to their stories. Now, more than forty people join the dinner every week, and some of them even teach the students to cook traditional dishes.

"I thought we were helping them," Yu-jie says. "But they have given us much more: their wisdom and their love."

What is the article mainly about?

listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)I get up at seven thirty every morning.
options: 時鐘指著 7 點 15 分
時鐘指著 6 點 30 分
時鐘指著 7 點 30 分
時鐘指著 8 點 30 分
questions.explanation: seven thirty 是 7 點 30 分，長針指 6、短針在 7 和 8 中間。7 點 15 分長針指 3；6 點 30 分和 8 點 30 分是小時聽錯。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The movie starts at a quarter to nine.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The movie starts at a quarter to nine.
options: 時鐘指著 8 點 45 分
時鐘指著 9 點 15 分
時鐘指著 9 點 45 分
時鐘指著 8 點 15 分
questions.explanation: a quarter to nine 是「差 15 分 9 點」，也就是 8 點 45 分，長針指 9、短針接近 9。9 點 15 分是 a quarter past nine；9 點 45 分是 a quarter to ten；8 點 15 分是 a quarter past eight。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The train left at ten past four.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The train left at ten past four.
options: 時鐘指著 4 點 50 分
時鐘指著 10 點 20 分
時鐘指著 3 點 50 分
時鐘指著 4 點 10 分
questions.explanation: ten past four 是 4 點過 10 分，即 4 點 10 分，長針指 2、短針剛過 4。4 點 50 分是 ten to five；3 點 50 分是 ten to four；10 點 20 分是把長短針看反了。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It will be rainy tomorrow.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)It will be rainy tomorrow.
questions.explanation: rainy 是下雨的，要選雲下面有雨滴的圖。太陽是 sunny，雪花是 snowy，只有雲是 cloudy。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It was sunny in the morning, but it rained in the afternoon.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)It was sunny in the morning, but it rained in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 上午 sunny（晴天）、下午 rained（下雨），所以 AM 是太陽、PM 是雨。上下午顛倒的不對；下午只是陰天、或上午是陰天的，都和內容不符。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It's snowing now, and it's minus five degrees outside.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)It's snowing now, and it's minus five degrees outside.
questions.explanation: snowing 是下雪，minus five degrees 是零下 5 度，要選雪花和 -5°C 的圖。5°C 少了 minus（零下）；晴天或下雨的天氣都不符。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: This T-shirt is two hundred and fifty dollars.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)This T-shirt is two hundred and fifty dollars.
questions.explanation: two hundred and fifty 是 250。215 是 two hundred and fifteen，205 是 two hundred and five，150 是 one hundred and fifty。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The pen is thirty dollars, and the notebook is fifty dollars.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The pen is thirty dollars, and the notebook is fifty dollars.
questions.explanation: 筆是 thirty（30 元）、筆記本是 fifty（50 元）。兩個價格對調的不對；fifteen 是 15、thirteen 是 13，要注意 -teen 和 -ty 的發音差別。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The cake was eighty dollars, but now it's twenty dollars off.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The cake was eighty dollars, but now it's twenty dollars off.
questions.explanation: 原價 eighty（80 元），twenty dollars off 是「便宜 20 元」，現價 80 - 20 = 60 元。現價 20 元是把 off 誤當成售價；原價 100 元不符；現價 100 元是把折扣加上去了。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The ball is under the table.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The ball is under the table.
questions.explanation: under the table 是在桌子下面。球在桌上是 on the table；在椅子下面或椅子上，地點都不對。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The cup is on the book, and the book is on the box.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The cup is on the book, and the book is on the box.
options: 由下往上依序是箱子、杯子、書
由下往上依序是書、箱子、杯子
由下往上依序是箱子、書、杯子
書放在箱子上，杯子在箱子旁的地上
questions.explanation: 杯子在書上、書在箱子上，所以由下往上是箱子、書、杯子。書在杯子上、箱子在書上都把順序弄反了；杯子放在地上也不符合 on the book。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: There's a clock above the door.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)There's a clock above the door.
questions.explanation: above the door 是在門的上方。掛在窗戶上方是 above the window；在門左邊、窗戶右邊都是 next to，不是 above。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: There are two balls in the box and one ball on the box.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)There are two balls in the box and one ball on the box.
options: 箱子裡有 2 顆球，箱子上有 1 顆球
箱子裡有 1 顆球，箱子上有 2 顆球
箱子裡有 2 顆球，箱子旁邊有 1 顆球
questions.explanation: in the box 是在箱子裡面（2 顆），on the box 是在箱子上面（1 顆）。數量對調的不對；球在箱子旁邊是 next to；3 顆都在箱子裡也不符。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The book is between the cup and the lamp.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The book is between the cup and the lamp.
options: 桌上由左到右是書、杯子、檯燈
桌上由左到右是杯子、檯燈、書
桌上由左到右是杯子、書、檯燈
桌上由左到右是書、檯燈、杯子
questions.explanation: between the cup and the lamp 是書在杯子和檯燈中間。其他三張圖中間的都不是書（分別是杯子或檯燈），書都在最旁邊。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: There are three cups and two books on the table.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)There are three cups and two books on the table.
options: 桌上有 2 個杯子和 3 本書
桌上有 3 個杯子和 2 本書
桌上有 3 個杯子和 3 本書
桌上有 2 個杯子和 2 本書
questions.explanation: three cups 是 3 個杯子，two books 是 2 本書。數量對調、或杯子和書數量相同的圖都不對。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I had four pencils, but I lost one of them.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)I had four pencils, but I lost one of them.
questions.explanation: 原本有 4 枝，lost one（弄丟 1 枝），現在剩 4 - 1 = 3 枝。4 枝是沒有扣掉弄丟的；5 枝是誤加；2 枝是多扣了。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I bought two boxes of eggs. There are six eggs in each box.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)I bought two boxes of eggs. There are six eggs in each box.
questions.explanation: two boxes 是 2 盒，six eggs in each box 是每盒 6 顆。只有 1 盒、每盒 4 顆或 3 盒都和內容不符。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
options: 直走，在第二個路口右轉
直走，在第一個路口左轉
直走，在第二個路口左轉
直走，在第一個路口右轉
questions.explanation: go straight 直走，turn left at the second corner 在第二個路口左轉。右轉的方向錯；在第一個路口轉彎則是路口錯。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The school is north of the park.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The school is north of the park.
questions.explanation: north of the park 是在公園的北邊；圖上 N 箭頭指向上方，所以學校要在公園上方。在下方是南邊（south），右邊是東邊（east），左邊是西邊（west）。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Turn right at the traffic light, and the shop will be on your left.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)Turn right at the traffic light, and the shop will be on your left.
options: 在紅綠燈右轉，商店在右轉後道路的右側
在紅綠燈右轉，商店在右轉後道路的左側
在紅綠燈左轉，商店在左轉後道路的左側
在紅綠燈左轉，商店在左轉後道路的右側
questions.explanation: 先在紅綠燈右轉；右轉後面向圖的右方前進，這時「左手邊」是道路的上側，所以商店要在右轉那段路的上方。商店在下方是 on your right；左轉的兩張圖則是轉彎方向錯。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Take the elevator up to the third floor.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)Take the elevator up to the third floor.
questions.explanation: the third floor 是 3 樓（3F）。second 是 2 樓，fourth 是 4 樓，first 是 1 樓。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: My birthday is on May twentieth.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)My birthday is on May twentieth.
questions.explanation: May twentieth 是 5 月 20 日。12 日是 twelfth，21 日是 twenty-first；MARCH 是 3 月，月份不對。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Today is Tuesday. Our school trip is the day after tomorrow.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)Today is Tuesday. Our school trip is the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 今天星期二，the day after tomorrow（後天）是星期四，要圈 Thu。星期三是 tomorrow（明天）；星期五是大後天；星期二是今天。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The shop is open from Monday to Friday.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)The shop is open from Monday to Friday.
options: 只有星期日打叉（星期一到六營業）
星期六、日打叉（星期一到五營業）
星期一、六、日打叉（星期二到五營業）
星期五、六、日打叉（星期一到四營業）
questions.explanation: from Monday to Friday 是星期一到星期五營業，所以只有星期六、日不開（打叉）。星期六也營業、星期一或星期五沒營業的圖都不對。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It's thirty-two degrees today. It's very hot.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)It's thirty-two degrees today. It's very hot.
questions.explanation: thirty-two 是 32 度，溫度計紅柱在 30 再往上兩小格。23 是 twenty-three（數字顛倒）；12 是 twelve；42 是 forty-two。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It was ten degrees at eight in the morning. At noon, it was five degrees warmer.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)It was ten degrees at eight in the morning. At noon, it was five degrees warmer.
questions.explanation: 早上 8 點是 10 度，中午 five degrees warmer（暖 5 度）是 10 + 5 = 15 度。中午 5 度是把 warmer 當成「變成 5 度」或變冷；8 點 15 度、中午 10 度是變冷；8 點 5 度的起點溫度不對。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I go to school by bus every day.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)I go to school by bus every day.
questions.explanation: by bus 是搭公車。腳踏車是 by bike，汽車是 by car，火車/捷運是 by train / by MRT。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: My father usually drives to work, but today he is taking the MRT.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)My father usually drives to work, but today he is taking the MRT.
questions.explanation: 爸爸平常開車（usually drives），但今天（today）搭捷運（taking the MRT），問的是今天，所以選捷運列車。汽車是平常的交通方式；公車、腳踏車都沒提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Tom is taller than Ben, but Ben is taller than Sam.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)Tom is taller than Ben, but Ben is taller than Sam.
options: 身高長條圖：Ben 最高、Tom 第二、Sam 最矮
身高長條圖：Tom 最高、Ben 第二、Sam 最矮
身高長條圖：Tom 最高、Sam 第二、Ben 最矮
身高長條圖：Sam 最高、Tom 第二、Ben 最矮
questions.explanation: Tom 比 Ben 高，Ben 又比 Sam 高，所以由高到矮是 Tom、Ben、Sam。Ben 最高的圖違反第一句；Sam 比 Ben 高的兩張圖違反第二句。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: We sold the most books on Wednesday and the fewest on Monday.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到內容相符的圖。
(聽力原文)We sold the most books on Wednesday and the fewest on Monday.
options: 賣書長條圖：星期一最多、星期三最少
賣書長條圖：星期二最多、星期一最少
賣書長條圖：星期三最多、星期二最少
賣書長條圖：星期三最多、星期一最少
questions.explanation: the most 在 Wednesday（星期三最多），the fewest 在 Monday（星期一最少）。最多、最少顛倒的不對；星期二最多或星期二最少的圖也都不符。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the bus timetable. Amy takes Bus 307 at Park Station, and she has to arrive at Sunny Junior High by 7:50. Which is the latest bus she can take?
questions.explanation: 時刻表顯示公車 7:05、7:20、7:35、7:50、8:05 從 Park Station 出發，車程 25 分鐘。7:20 的車 7:45 到校，趕得上 7:50；7:35 的車 8:00 才到，來不及；7:50 那班更晚。7:05 雖然趕得上，但不是「最晚」能搭的一班，所以答案是 7:20。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the menu. Milk tea is ______ drink on the menu.
questions.explanation: 菜單上 Milk Tea 45 元，比紅茶 25 元、綠茶 30 元、檸檬汁 40 元都貴，是最貴的，用最高級 the most expensive。它不是最便宜的（最便宜是紅茶）；cheaper、more expensive 是比較級，後面沒有比較對象，也不能接在空格裡修飾 drink。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the chart. Which sentence is true?
options: Ben read as long as David.
David read the longest of the four.
Cindy read fewer hours than Ben.
questions.explanation: 圖中 Amy 6 小時、Ben 4 小時、Cindy 9 小時、David 4 小時。Ben 和 David 都是 4 小時，所以 as long as（一樣久）正確。Amy 6 小時比 Cindy 9 小時少；讀最久的是 Cindy 不是 David；Cindy 9 小時比 Ben 多，不是 fewer。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the sign. Which is true?
options: You can swim here at 7 p.m.
You must swim here after 6 p.m.
You can't swim here before 6 p.m.
You can swim here at 5 p.m.
questions.explanation: 告示寫 NO SWIMMING after 6 p.m.，表示晚上 6 點以後禁止游泳，6 點以前可以，所以下午 5 點可以游（can swim at 5 p.m.）。晚上 7 點已經過了 6 點，不能游；告示沒有規定「必須」游泳；6 點以前並沒有禁止。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the sign. When can Ken go to the library?
questions.explanation: 圖書館星期一到五 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. 開放，星期六 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.，星期日休館。星期三晚上 7 點在開放時間內。星期六晚上 8 點已過 5 點閉館；星期日不開；星期一早上 8 點還沒到 9 點開館。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: 未來式 will 與 be going to
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the weather forecast. What will the weather be like on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: 氣象預報中 Tue（星期二）的圖示是雲，26°C，所以會是陰天 cloudy。晴天是星期一和星期五，下雨是星期三和星期四；整週都沒有下雪。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the timetable. Tom gets to Taipei Station at 8:20. He wants to arrive in Tainan as early as possible. Which train should he take?
options: He can't take any train to Tainan.
questions.explanation: Tom 8:20 才到台北站，8:00 開的 121 次已經開走了。剩下 135 次（8:30 開，11:40 到台南）和 152 次（9:10 開，10:50 到台南），152 次雖然較晚出發但較早到台南，所以搭 152 次。還有車可搭，所以「不能搭任何火車」不對。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the poster. Mr. Lin goes to the book fair with his son and his daughter. His son is a 13-year-old student, and his daughter is 4 years old. How much do they pay in all?
questions.explanation: 票價：大人 100 元、學生 60 元、6 歲以下兒童免費。林先生 100 元，13 歲的兒子是學生 60 元，4 歲的女兒免費，共 100 + 60 = 160 元。220 元是把女兒也算成學生票；260 元是把兒子算成大人票；200 元是兩張大人票。

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the chart. Which sentence is true?
options: The zoo had more visitors in 2023 than in 2024.
The zoo had the most visitors in 2023.
The zoo had fewer visitors in 2025 than in 2024.
The zoo had the same number of visitors in 2022 and 2024.

questions.subject: 英語
questions.unit: be 動詞與一般動詞現在式
questions.stem: 看圖回答問題：Look at the sign. Kevin buys one T-shirt and one cap today. How much does he pay?
questions.explanation: 價格牌是特價前的價錢：T 恤 300 元、帽子 200 元，共 500 元；今天全部 20% OFF（打八折），500 × 0.8 = 400 元。500 元是沒有打折；440 元是只有 T 恤打折（240 + 200）；480 元是 600 打八折，算成兩件 T 恤。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Where is your English teacher from?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Where is your English teacher from?
options: She is in the office now.
questions.explanation: 問句「Where is your English teacher from?」問的是老師來自哪裡（from），應回答國家「She's from Canada.」。「在辦公室」回答的是人現在在哪裡，漏聽了 from；描述外表個性或說她教英文都沒有回答來自哪裡。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Do you have any brothers or sisters?
options: Yes, I have an older brother.
questions.explanation: 對方問有沒有兄弟姊妹，回答「有一個哥哥」最適當。「我不喜歡他們」答非所問；「他們是我的朋友」與兄弟姊妹無關；「他不是我的兄弟」是在否認某人的身分，不是回答有沒有兄弟姊妹。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Let's have lunch together.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Let's have lunch together.
options: Yes, I already had lunch at home.
Sure. Where do you want to eat?
questions.explanation: 對方提議一起吃午餐，接受提議並問要去哪裡吃最適當。「很好吃」是品嘗食物後的回應；「現在十二點」回答的是時間；「我在家吃過了」用 Yes 開頭卻表示已經吃過，前後矛盾，也沒有回應邀約。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I have a bad headache.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)I have a bad headache.
options: Oh no. You should see a doctor.
Good for you. I'm glad to hear that.
questions.explanation: 對方說自己頭很痛，應表示關心並給建議。「Good for you.」是恭喜別人的用語；「我也是，我喜歡」不合情理；「是的，那是我的頭」沒有回應對方的不舒服。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: How many students are there in your class?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)How many students are there in your class?
questions.explanation: 「How many students」問班上有幾個學生，回答人數「There are thirty.」。「三個班」回答的是班級數量，不是學生人數；「他們很友善」描述個性；「我在七班」回答的是哪一班。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: What are you doing now?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)What are you doing now?
options: I do my homework every night.
questions.explanation: 問句用現在進行式並有 now，問的是「現在正在做什麼」，應用現在進行式回答「I'm doing my homework.」。「每晚都寫作業」是習慣，不是現在；「昨天做了」是過去；wh 問句不能用 Yes 回答。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Is this your notebook?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Is this your notebook?
questions.explanation: 問「這是你的筆記本嗎？」，回答「不是，是 Ben 的」最適當。「Yes, it is yours.」把所有格說成對方的，前後矛盾；「在桌上」回答的是位置；「是一本書」回答的是物品是什麼。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Can I use your pen?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Can I use your pen?
questions.explanation: 對方請求借用筆，答應並把筆遞給對方「Sure. Here you are.」最適當。「Yes, you are.」文法上不能回答 Can I 問句；「不，這是一支筆」答非所問；「我可以用它」把主詞弄錯了。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Tom is never late for school.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)Tom is never late for school.
options: Tom always gets to school on time.
Tom is sometimes late for school.
Tom is always late for school.
questions.explanation: never late 表示「從不遲到」，意思就是總是準時到校（always on time）。sometimes late 是「有時遲到」；always late 意思正好相反；句子並沒有說 Tom 不上學。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: My sister is two years older than me. I am twelve.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)My sister is two years older than me. I am twelve.
questions.explanation: 姊姊比我大兩歲（two years older），我十二歲，所以姊姊是 12 + 2 = 14 歲。十歲是誤用減法；十二歲表示同年齡；二歲是只聽到 two 而誤選。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: The store opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)The store opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
options: The store is open for six hours a day.
The store is open for nine hours a day.
The store is open for three hours a day.
The store is open for fifteen hours a day.
questions.explanation: 早上九點開到晚上六點，共 9 小時（9 點到 12 點 3 小時，再加 12 點到 6 點 6 小時）。六小時只算了中午以後；三小時是直接 9 − 6；十五小時是把 9 + 6。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: Can I help you?
W: Yes, I'm looking for a cap for my son.
M: How about this blue one?
W: He likes red. Do you have a red one?
M: Yes. Here you are.

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。What does the woman want to buy?

W: Yes, I'm looking for a cap for my son.
M: How about this blue one?
W: He likes red. Do you have a red one?
M: Yes. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 女士要幫兒子買帽子（cap），店員推薦藍色的，但她說兒子喜歡紅色，所以她要買紅色帽子。藍色帽子是店員推薦的；襯衫和袋子對話中沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
W: This is my brother, Leo.
M: He looks so young. Is he five?
W: No, he is seven. He's in second grade.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。How old is Leo?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。How old is Leo?
(聽力原文)W: This is my brother, Leo.
M: He looks so young. Is he five?
W: No, he is seven. He's in second grade.
questions.explanation: 男士猜 Leo 五歲，女士回答「No, he is seven.」，所以 Leo 七歲。五歲是男士猜錯的年齡；二是讀二年級（second grade）的干擾；十二對話中沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: Mom, can I go to the movies with Peter on Saturday?
W: Saturday? We're visiting Grandma on Saturday.
M: Then can I go on Sunday?
W: OK, but come home before dinner.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。What will the boy do this Sunday?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。What will the boy do this Sunday?
(聽力原文)M: Mom, can I go to the movies with Peter on Saturday?
W: Saturday? We're visiting Grandma on Saturday.
M: Then can I go on Sunday?
W: OK, but come home before dinner.
questions.explanation: 週六全家要去看奶奶，男孩改問週日能否去看電影，媽媽答應了，所以他週日會和 Peter 看電影。看奶奶是週六的事；媽媽要他晚餐前回家，不是和 Peter 吃晚餐；他不會整天待在家。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:

W: Is it on the sofa?
M: No, it isn't.
W: Look! It's in your jacket pocket.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。Where is the man's phone?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。Where is the man's phone?
(聽力原文)M: Where's my phone? I can't find it.
W: Is it on the sofa?
M: No, it isn't.
W: Look! It's in your jacket pocket.
options: On the sofa in the living room.
questions.explanation: 女士先問是不是在沙發上，男士說不是；最後女士發現手機在他的外套口袋裡。沙發上已被否定；沙發下和桌上對話中沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: How much is the milk?
W: It's twenty-five dollars.
M: And the sandwich?
W: It's forty dollars.
M: I'll take two bottles of milk and one sandwich.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。How much will the man pay?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。How much will the man pay?
(聽力原文)M: How much is the milk?
W: It's twenty-five dollars.
M: And the sandwich?
W: It's forty dollars.
M: I'll take two bottles of milk and one sandwich.
questions.explanation: 牛奶一瓶 25 元，買兩瓶是 50 元，再加一個三明治 40 元，共 90 元。65 元是只算一瓶牛奶加一個三明治；105 元是把數量聽反，算成一瓶牛奶加兩個三明治；130 元是把牛奶和三明治都算兩份。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
W: Let's go to the beach today.
M: But it's cloudy and windy.
W: The weather report says it'll be sunny tomorrow.
M: Then let's go tomorrow.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。What is the weather like today?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。What is the weather like today?
(聽力原文)W: Let's go to the beach today.
M: But it's cloudy and windy.
W: The weather report says it'll be sunny tomorrow.
M: Then let's go tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 男士說今天「cloudy and windy」（多雲有風），晴天是氣象預報說的明天天氣。下雨、下雪對話中都沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: You look happy, Kelly.
W: Yes. My aunt gave me a new bike for my birthday.
M: Wow, lucky you!
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。Why is Kelly happy?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。Why is Kelly happy?
(聽力原文)M: You look happy, Kelly.
W: Yes. My aunt gave me a new bike for my birthday.
M: Wow, lucky you!
options: She got a bike as a gift.
questions.explanation: Kelly 說阿姨送她一台新腳踏車當生日禮物，所以她很開心。腳踏車不是她自己買的；對話沒說阿姨來拜訪；也沒有提到比賽。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Hi, I'm Lily. I'm very busy every weekend. On Saturday morning, I have a piano lesson. In the afternoon, I play tennis with my father. On Sunday, I stay at home and help my mother clean the house.
listening.prompt: 請根據內容回答問題。What does Lily do on Sunday?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據內容回答問題。What does Lily do on Sunday?
(聽力原文)Hi, I'm Lily. I'm very busy every weekend. On Saturday morning, I have a piano lesson. In the afternoon, I play tennis with my father. On Sunday, I stay at home and help my mother clean the house.
options: She cleans the house with her mother.
She plays tennis with her father.
She goes shopping with her mother downtown.
questions.explanation: Lily 說週日待在家幫媽媽打掃房子。鋼琴課是週六早上，和爸爸打網球是週六下午；購物沒有提到。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script:
M: Let's meet at the MRT station at two thirty.
W: Sorry, my dance class ends at two thirty. Can we meet thirty minutes later?
M: OK. See you then.
listening.prompt: 請根據對話回答問題。What time will they meet?

questions.stem:
【聽力】請根據對話回答問題。What time will they meet?
(聽力原文)M: Let's meet at the MRT station at two thirty.
W: Sorry, my dance class ends at two thirty. Can we meet thirty minutes later?
M: OK. See you then.
questions.explanation: 原本約兩點半，但女士的舞蹈課兩點半才結束，她要求晚三十分鐘，所以改成三點見面。兩點半是原本的時間；兩點是往前算；三點半是多加了一小時。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: You'd better take an umbrella with you.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)You'd better take an umbrella with you.
options: Why? Is it going to rain?
Thanks, but it isn't my umbrella.
questions.explanation: 對方建議帶傘，最自然的回應是追問原因「會下雨嗎？」。「昨天在下雨」與現在的建議無關；「我最好不要去」誤解了 had better 的意思；「這不是我的傘」答非所問。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: How long does it take you to get to school?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)How long does it take you to get to school?
options: I usually go to school at seven thirty.
questions.explanation: 「How long does it take…」問花多少時間，回答「騎腳踏車大約二十分鐘」。「七點去上學」回答的是什麼時候；「從去年開始」回答 how long 搭配完成式的問題；「除了週日每天」回答的是多常。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: I'm thinking of joining the school band.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)I'm thinking of joining the school band.
options: Really? When did you join the band?
The band played really well last night.
Good idea! You play the drums well.
questions.explanation: 對方說正在考慮（thinking of）加入學校樂團，表示還沒加入，所以鼓勵他最適當。「你什麼時候加入的？」誤以為已經加入；「樂團昨晚表演很好」沒有回應對方的打算；「我現在沒在想」誤解了 think of 的意思。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Have you finished the book I lent you?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Have you finished the book I lent you?
options: Yes, I'll lend it to you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 書是對方借給我的，問我讀完了沒，回答「快讀完了，明天還你」最適當。書是對方的，說「我借給你」或「你可以借」都把借出借入的關係弄反了；「我從沒讀過」與已經借來的情境不合。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Thanks for inviting me. I really had a good time.
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)Thanks for inviting me. I really had a good time.
options: I'm glad you enjoyed it. Come again.
questions.explanation: 客人道謝並說玩得很開心，主人回應「很高興你喜歡，再來玩」最適當。「很糟糕」與對方的感受矛盾；「抱歉我不能來」是拒絕邀請；「Me, neither.」用於附和否定句。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: What do you think of the new science teacher?
listening.prompt: 請選出最適當的回應。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出最適當的回應。
(聽力原文)What do you think of the new science teacher?
options: I think she will come to our school tomorrow.
She teaches us science on Mondays.
She's strict, but her classes are fun.
questions.explanation: 「What do you think of…?」是詢問對某人的看法，回答「她很嚴格，但上課很有趣」最適當。「她明天會來」與看法無關；「她教我們自然」只是重複事實；「I don't think so.」用於不同意某說法。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Jack is the tallest student in our class.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)Jack is the tallest student in our class.
options: Jack is shorter than most students in our class.
Some students in our class are taller than Jack.
No one in our class is taller than Jack.
Jack is as tall as the other students.
questions.explanation: Jack 是班上最高的，也就是班上沒有人比他高。「比多數同學矮」「有些同學比他高」都和原意相反；「跟其他同學一樣高」也不符合最高的意思。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: It took me three hours to finish the report.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)It took me three hours to finish the report.
options: I finished the report three hours ago.
I have three reports to finish.
I spent three hours on the report.
Three people helped me finish the report.
questions.explanation: 「It took me three hours to…」表示做某事花了三小時，等於「I spent three hours on…」。「三小時前完成」說的是時間點；「有三份報告」和「三個人幫忙」都誤用了 three。

questions.subject: 英語

listening.script: Amy moved to Kaohsiung when she was six. She is fifteen now, and she still lives there.
listening.prompt: 請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。

questions.stem:
【聽力】請選出與聽到的句子意思最接近的選項。
(聽力原文)Amy moved to Kaohsiung when she was six. She is fifteen now, and she still lives there.
options: Amy has lived in Kaohsiung for nine years.
Amy has lived in Kaohsiung for six years.
Amy has lived in Kaohsiung for fifteen years.
Amy moved away from Kaohsiung nine years ago.
questions.explanation: Amy 六歲搬到高雄，現在十五歲仍住在那裡，所以已住了 15 − 6 = 9 年。六年、十五年是直接用聽到的數字；她沒有搬離高雄，「九年前搬走」意思相反。

Dad came home at six with a big box. It was a new puzzle with one thousand pieces! After dinner, our whole family worked on it together. We finished half of it before bedtime.

I hope it will be sunny next Sunday, so we can go to the zoo.

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Dear Ms. Wang,

I'm an eighth grader. My best friend, Jenny, and I have been friends since we were six. But this year, we're in different classes. She has made many new friends, and she always has lunch with them. Last week, I saw a photo online of Jenny and her new friends at the movies. She didn't ask me to go with them. I felt sad and left out. Should I stop being her friend?

Lonely Lily

Dear Lily,

I understand how you feel. When a good friend spends less time with us, it is natural to feel sad. But it doesn't always mean she doesn't care about you. Maybe Jenny thought you were busy, or maybe she just didn't think about it. Why don't you talk to her and tell her how you feel? You can also invite her to do something fun, just the two of you. And don't forget that you can make new friends in your own class, too. Having new friends doesn't mean losing old ones.

Ms. Wang

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Many years ago, an old man was planting some small trees in his yard. A young man walked by and laughed at him. "Why are you planting those trees? It will take twenty years for them to grow fruit. You may not even be alive then!"

The old man smiled and said, "When I was a child, I ate fruit from trees that my grandfather planted. Now I'm planting trees for my grandchildren."

The young man stopped laughing. He didn't say anything and walked away.

Twenty years later, the young man came back to the same place. The old man was gone, but the trees were tall and full of fruit. Some children were playing under the trees and eating the fruit. The man stood there for a long time. That spring, he went home and planted some trees in his own yard.

Why did the young man laugh at the old man at first?

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Many years ago, an old man was planting some small trees in his yard. A young man walked by and laughed at him. "Why are you planting those trees? It will take twenty years for them to grow fruit. You may not even be alive then!"

The old man smiled and said, "When I was a child, I ate fruit from trees that my grandfather planted. Now I'm planting trees for my grandchildren."

The young man stopped laughing. He didn't say anything and walked away.

Twenty years later, the young man came back to the same place. The old man was gone, but the trees were tall and full of fruit. Some children were playing under the trees and eating the fruit. The man stood there for a long time. That spring, he went home and planted some trees in his own yard.

How did the young man change at the end of the story?

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Every year, a lot of fruit and vegetables never reach our tables. The reason is not that they are bad, but that they look "ugly." A carrot with two legs or an apple with a strange shape may taste just as good as a perfect one, but many supermarkets don't want to sell them. They believe shoppers only buy food that looks nice. As a result, farmers often have to throw this food away.

Some people are trying to change this. In some countries, supermarkets have started selling ugly fruit and vegetables at lower prices. Some young people have also started online shops that buy ugly food from farmers and send it to people's homes. Their customers save money, farmers earn more, and less food is wasted.

However, not everyone is happy about this. Some farmers say the prices are still too low, so they can't make much money. Some shoppers also say they will buy ugly food only when it is much cheaper. It seems that people's ideas about what "good" food looks like will take time to change.

What is the reading mainly about?

questions.subject: 英語
questions.stem:
Every morning before school, Mia found a note from her father on the fridge. He worked at night as a taxi driver, so when Mia got up, he was usually sleeping. The notes were short: "Eat your eggs." "Don't forget your umbrella." "Good luck on your test!" Mia read them quickly but never wrote back.

When Mia became a ninth grader, she began to think the notes were only for little kids. One day, she threw a note away without reading it. The next morning, there was no note on the fridge. The morning after that, there was still no note. Mia told herself she didn't care, but the kitchen felt strangely quiet.

On the third night, Mia couldn't sleep. At two in the morning, she heard the door open. Her father came in, took a piece of paper out of his pocket, looked at it for a long time, and then put it back. Mia saw his tired face and suddenly understood.

The next morning, there was a new note on the fridge. But this time, it was in Mia's handwriting: "Dad, drive safely tonight. I miss your notes."

Why did Mia's father leave notes for her?

To help ninth graders get ready for the exam, the study room on the fourth floor will stay open longer from April 1 to May 15.

Opening Hours
Monday to Friday: 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.
Saturday: 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Sunday: Closed

Rules
1. Only ninth graders may use the room. Please show your student ID card at the door.
2. Sign up for a seat on the school website at least one day before. If you are more than 30 minutes late, your seat may be given to someone else.
3. You may bring water, but no other food or drinks.
4. Keep your phone silent. If you need to make a phone call, please go outside.

Students who break the rules three times will not be allowed to use the room again.

questions.groupStem: Tim signed up for a seat on Saturday. He gets to the study room at 9:40 a.m. What may happen?
options: He will never be allowed to use the room again.
He has to wait until the room opens.
Someone else may get his seat.
He can't come in because it is closed on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 週六 9:00 開放，Tim 9:40 才到，遲到超過三十分鐘，依規則二他的座位可能被讓給別人。違規三次才會被禁止使用，遲到一次不會；9:40 時自習室已經開了；週六有開放，週日才休息。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個數不是整數？
questions.explanation: 整數包含正整數、零與負整數，3/4 是分數，不屬於整數。
questions.explanationRich: 整數包含正整數、零與負整數，$\frac{3}{4}$ 是分數，不屬於整數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，−3 與 5 之間（不含端點）共有幾個整數？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上距離原點 4 個單位的點，其座標為何？
questions.explanation: 距原點 4 個單位可在原點右側（座標 4）或左側（座標 −4），共兩點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列各數由小到大排列，何者正確？
questions.explanation: 在數線上越往左數值越小，負數中絕對值越大的數越小，故 −5 < −3 < 0 < 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: −8 的絕對值是多少？
questions.explanation: 絕對值表示數到原點的距離，恆為非負數，|−8| = 8。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若一個整數的絕對值為 5，則這個整數有幾個？
questions.explanation: 絕對值為 5 的整數為 5 與 −5，共 2 個。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，座標為 −6 的點在座標為 −2 的點的哪一側？
questions.explanation: −6 < −2，在數線上較小的數位於較大的數左側，所以 −6 在 −2 的左側。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列敘述何者正確？
options: 正整數的絕對值是負數
負整數的絕對值是負數
任何數的絕對值都大於 0
questions.explanation: |0| = 0，零的絕對值為零本身。其餘選項均有誤。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，A 點座標為 −4，B 點座標為 3，則 A、B 兩點之間的距離是多少？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個說法正確？
questions.explanation: 0 位於數線正中間，所有負數均在 0 左側，故 0 大於所有負數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 比較 |−9| 與 |6| 的大小，下列何者正確？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 整數 −10、−1、0、7、−4 中，最大的數是哪一個？
questions.explanation: 在數線上最靠右的數最大，正數 7 大於 0 及所有負數，故最大為 7。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上與 −3 的距離為 5 個單位長的點，所代表的數為何？
questions.explanation: 從 −3 往右走 5 個單位是 −3 + 5 = 2，往左走 5 個單位是 −3 − 5 = −8，所以有兩個點：2 或 −8。只寫一個答案會漏掉另一側；8 或 −2 則是誤以為從 3 出發。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，從 −3 向右移動 7 格，到達的點座標為何？
questions.explanation: 向右移動表示加法，−3 + 7 = 4，所以到達座標 4 的點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 數線上，從 5 向左移動 9 格，到達的點座標為何？
questions.explanation: 向左移動表示減法，5 − 9 = −4，所以到達座標 −4 的點。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 a 為負整數且 |a| = 6，則 a = ？
questions.explanation: 絕對值為 6 的整數有 6 與 −6 兩個，題目限定 a 為負整數，故 a = −6。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列四個數：−5、−3、−8、−1，由大到小排列何者正確？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是「−3 的相反數」？
questions.explanation: 一個數的相反數就是在數線上與它距原點相同、方向相反的數，−3 的相反數為 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 在數線上，下列哪一個點在 −2 的右側且在 3 的左側？
questions.explanation: 需滿足 −2 < x < 3，選項中只有 1 滿足此條件（−2 < 1 < 3）。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明說：「絕對值最小的整數是 1。」這句話是否正確？
options: 不正確，因為絕對值最小的整數是 −1
正確，因為 1 是最小的正整數
正確，因為負整數的絕對值都大於 1
不正確，因為絕對值最小的整數是 0
questions.explanation: |0| = 0，是所有整數中絕對值最小的，所以絕對值最小的整數是 0，小明的說法不正確。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 1/2 + 1/3 的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 通分後，1/2 = 3/6，1/3 = 2/6，相加得 5/6。分母不同時需先取最小公倍數再相加。
questions.stemRich: 計算 $\frac{1}{2}$ + $\frac{1}{3}$ 的結果為何？
questions.explanationRich: 通分後，$\frac{1}{2}$ = $\frac{3}{6}$，$\frac{1}{3}$ = $\frac{2}{6}$，相加得 $\frac{5}{6}$。分母不同時需先取最小公倍數再相加。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 3/4 - 1/6 的結果為何？
questions.stemRich: 計算 $\frac{3}{4}$ - $\frac{1}{6}$ 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 2/5 × 5/8 的結果為何？
questions.stemRich: 計算 $\frac{2}{5}$ × $\frac{5}{8}$ 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 3/7 ÷ 6/14 的結果為何？
questions.stemRich: 計算 $\frac{3}{7}$ ÷ $\frac{6}{14}$ 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 0.25 化成最簡分數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 分數 5/8 化成小數為何？
questions.stemRich: 分數 $\frac{5}{8}$ 化成小數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 1又2/3 + 2又1/4 的結果為何？
questions.stemRich: 計算 $1\frac{2}{3}$ + $2\frac{1}{4}$ 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 2又1/2 - 1又3/4 的結果為何？
questions.stemRich: 計算 $2\frac{1}{2}$ - $1\frac{3}{4}$ 的結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.explanation: 將除數化為整數，2.4 ÷ 0.6 = 24 ÷ 6 = 4，除數與被除數同乘 10。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個分數最大？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個小數最小？
questions.explanation: 比較各位數：整數位皆相同，小數第一位皆為 5，再比小數第二位，0.5 的第二位為 0 最小，故 0.5 最小。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 1/3 的小數表示為循環小數，其循環節為何？
questions.explanation: 1÷3 = 0.333…，小數部分的 3 不斷循環，循環節為 3。
questions.stemRich: $\frac{1}{3}$ 的小數表示為循環小數，其循環節為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲有 3/4 公升果汁，乙有 5/6 公升果汁，兩人共有多少公升？
questions.stemRich: 甲有 $\frac{3}{4}$ 公升果汁，乙有 $\frac{5}{6}$ 公升果汁，兩人共有多少公升？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一條繩子長 2.5 公尺，裁成每段 0.25 公尺，共可裁幾段？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列分數中，哪一個等於 0.375？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明每天跑 1又3/4 公里，7 天共跑多少公里？
questions.stemRich: 小明每天跑 $1\frac{3}{4}$ 公里，7 天共跑多少公里？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 0.1 的平方的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 0.1 的平方 = 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01，兩個小數相乘，小數位數相加共 2 位。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 3/5 和 4/7 哪個較大？兩數差為多少？
questions.stemRich: $\frac{3}{5}$ 和 $\frac{4}{7}$ 哪個較大？兩數差為多少？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一桶水有 4又1/2 公升，倒出 1又2/3 公升後，剩下多少公升？
questions.stemRich: 一桶水有 $4\frac{1}{2}$ 公升，倒出 $1\frac{2}{3}$ 公升後，剩下多少公升？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 2x + 5 = 13，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 將 5 移項得 2x = 8，兩邊除以 2 得 x = 4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 3x - 7 = 2，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 3x = 9，兩邊除以 3 得 x = 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 5(x - 2) = 15，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 x/3 + 2 = 5，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 x/3 = 3，兩邊乘以 3 得 x = 9。
questions.stemRich: 解方程式 $\frac{x}{3}$ + 2 = 5，x 的值為何？
questions.explanationRich: 移項得 $\frac{x}{3}$ = 3，兩邊乘以 3 得 x = 9。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明的年齡是小華年齡的 2 倍，兩人年齡相差 8 歲，則小明幾歲？
questions.explanation: 設小華年齡為 x，則小明為 2x，依題意 2x - x = 8，x = 8，小明為 16 歲。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 4x + 3 = 2x + 11，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 2(3x - 1) = 4(x + 2)，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個數的 3 倍加上 4 等於該數的 5 倍減去 6，這個數是多少？
questions.explanation: 設這個數為 x，依題意 3x + 4 = 5x - 6，移項得 -2x = -10，x = 5。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一件衣服打八折後售價為 480 元，原價是多少元？
questions.explanation: 設原價為 x，依題意 0.8 × x = 480，x = 600。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 7 - 3x = 1，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 移項得 -3x = 1 - 7 = -6，兩邊除以 -3 得 x = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是方程式 2x - 3 = 7 的解？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲、乙兩數之和為 50，甲數比乙數多 10，則甲數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 (x + 1)/2 = (x - 1)/3，x 的值為何？
questions.stemRich: 解方程式 $\frac{x + 1}{2}$ = $\frac{x - 1}{3}$，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一條繩子剪去 1/4 後，剩下 90 公分，原來繩子長幾公分？
questions.explanation: 設繩子原長為 x，剪去 1/4 後剩 3/4，依題意 (3/4) × x = 90，x = 120。
questions.stemRich: 一條繩子剪去 $\frac{1}{4}$ 後，剩下 90 公分，原來繩子長幾公分？
questions.explanationRich: 設繩子原長為 x，剪去 $\frac{1}{4}$ 後剩 $\frac{3}{4}$，依題意 ($\frac{3}{4}$) × x = 90，x = 120。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 3x + a = 10，且 x = 2，則 a 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 兩個連續整數之和為 37，這兩個連續整數中較大的一個是多少？
questions.explanation: 設較小整數為 x，則較大為 x + 1，依題意 x + (x+1) = 37，2x = 36，x = 18，較大整數為 19。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 5x - 2(x + 3) = 12，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 購買 5 枝鉛筆和 2 枝原子筆共花 34 元，若原子筆每枝 7 元，鉛筆每枝幾元？
questions.explanation: 設鉛筆每枝 x 元，依題意 5x + 2 × 7 = 34，5x = 20，x = 4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列方程式中，哪一個的解為負數？
questions.explanation: 解 2x + 6 = 4 得 2x = -2，x = -1，為負數；其餘解均為正數。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 某班同學人數，男生比女生多 6 人，全班共 38 人，則女生有幾人？
questions.explanation: 設女生為 x 人，男生為 x + 6，依題意 x + (x + 6) = 38，2x = 32，x = 16。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解方程式 3(x + 2) - 2(x - 1) = 11，x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個長方形的周長為 36 公分，長比寬多 4 公分，則長為幾公分？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 x + y = 7 且 x - y = 3，則 x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相加得 2x = 10，故 x = 5。再代入得 y = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 二元一次方程式 2x + y = 8 中，當 x = 3 時，y 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 用代入消去法解聯立方程式：y = 2x - 1 且 3x + y = 14，則 x + y 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 用加減消去法解：2x + 3y = 12 且 2x - y = 4，則 y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相減（第一式減第二式）得 4y = 8，故 y = 2。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 某班男生比女生多 6 人，全班共 38 人。設男生 x 人、女生 y 人，下列哪一個聯立方程式正確描述此情境？
questions.explanation: 全班人數：x + y = 38；男生比女生多 6：x - y = 6。兩式合在一起即為正確聯立方程式。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解聯立方程式：x + 2y = 10 且 3x - 2y = 6，則 x × y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相加得 4x = 16，x = 4，代回第一式得 y = 3，故 x × y = 4 × 3 = 12。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列關於二元一次方程式 ax + by = c 的敘述，何者正確？
options: 此方程式恰好有兩組解，圖形為兩個點
係數 a、b 可以同時為 0，仍是二元一次方程式
此方程式在座標平面上的圖形為一條直線
此方程式只有唯一一組解，且必為整數解
questions.explanation: 二元一次方程式在座標平面上的圖形為一條直線，有無窮多組解（不限整數）。a、b 不可同時為 0。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 用代入消去法解：y = x + 4 且 2x + y = 19，則 y - x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若聯立方程式 3x + ky = 10 且 x - 2y = 0 的解為 x = 2，則 k 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲、乙兩數之和為 20，甲數的 2 倍比乙數多 4，則甲數為多少？
questions.explanation: 設甲為 x、乙為 y。x + y = 20 且 2x - y = 4。兩式相加：3x = 24，x = 8。故甲數為 8。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個兩位數，個位數字與十位數字之和為 11，將個位與十位對調後的新數比原數大 27，則原來的兩位數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 解聯立方程式：5x + 2y = 16 且 5x - 3y = 1，則 x + y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相減得 5y = 15，y = 3。代回第一式：5x + 6 = 16，x = 2。故 x + y = 5。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個聯立方程式的解為 (x, y) = (1, -2)？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 一個長方形的周長為 36 公分，長比寬多 4 公分，則長方形的面積為多少平方公分？
questions.explanation: 設長為 x、寬為 y。2(x + y) = 36 即 x + y = 18；x - y = 4。解得 x = 11，y = 7。面積 = 11 × 7 = 77 平方公分。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 2x + y = 7 且 x + 2y = 8，則 x + y 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 兩式相加：3x + 3y = 15，故 x + y = 5。此技巧不需個別求 x、y，直接得到答案。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若聯立方程式 ax + by = 5 且 ax - by = 3 的解為 x = 2、y = 1，則 a - b 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 代入第一式：2a + b = 5；代入第二式：2a - b = 3。兩式相加：4a = 8，a = 2，b = 1。故 a - b = 1。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲、乙兩數之比為 3：5，若甲數為 12，則乙數為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 將 48 依照 1：3 的比分成兩部分，較大的部分為何？
questions.explanation: 48 分成 1 份和 3 份，共 4 份，每份 12，較大部分為 3 份，即 3 × 12 = 36。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 比例式 4：x = 12：9 中，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 由比例式外項積等於內項積：4 × 9 = 12 × x，36 = 12x，x = 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 a：b = 2：3，b：c = 6：5，則 a：c 為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個比與 15：20 相等？
questions.explanation: 15：20 化簡，兩項同除以最大公因數 5，得 3：4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小明和小華的零用錢之比為 5：4，兩人共有 270 元，則小明有多少元？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 比例式 x：6 = 10：15 中，x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: 外項積等於內項積：15x = 60，x = 4。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲班男女生人數之比為 3：2，若女生有 16 人，則全班共有幾人？
questions.explanation: 女生 16 人對應 2 份，每份 8 人，男生 3 份為 24 人，全班 24 + 16 = 40 人。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 6：x = x：24，則 x 的值為何（取正值）？
questions.explanation: 由比例式外項積等於內項積：6 × 24 = x²，x² = 144，x = 12。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 食譜規定麵粉與糖的重量比為 4：1。若麵粉用了 200 公克，需要糖幾公克？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 甲、乙、丙三人分配獎金之比為 2：3：5，若丙得到 500 元，則甲得到多少元？
questions.explanation: 丙 500 元對應 5 份，每份 100 元，甲對應 2 份，得 2 × 100 = 200 元。

questions.explanation: 2 公分：5 公里 = 7 公分：x 公里，2x = 35，x = 17.5 公里。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 小英以每小時 60 公里的速度行駛，與小強以每小時 45 公里行駛，兩人同時出發，1 小時後兩人行駛距離之比為何？
questions.explanation: 1 小時後，小英行 60 公里，小強行 45 公里，距離比 60：45 = 4：3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 已知比例式 (2x - 1)：3 = 5：3，則 x 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 展開 (x + 3)(x - 3) 的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 利用平方差公式 (a + b)(a - b) = a² - b²，代入 a = x、b = 3，得 x² - 9。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 展開 (2x + 5)² 的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 利用完全平方公式 (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²，代入 a = 2x、b = 5，得 4x² + 2×2x×5 + 25 = 4x² + 20x + 25。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 展開 (3x - 4)² 的結果為何？
questions.explanation: 利用完全平方公式 (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b²，代入 a = 3x、b = 4，得 9x² - 2×3x×4 + 16 = 9x² - 24x + 16。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個多項式可以因式分解為 (x + a)(x + b) 的形式，其中 a、b 均為正整數？
questions.explanation: x² + 5x + 6 = (x + 2)(x + 3)，此時 a = 2、b = 3 均為正整數，符合條件。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 101² 的值，最簡便的方法是利用乘法公式，其結果為何？

questions.stem: 計算 99 × 101 的值為何？

questions.stem: 若 x + y = 5，xy = 3，則 x² + y² 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 多項式 3x² - 6x + 9 除以 3 後，化簡結果為何？
questions.explanation: 將多項式每一項都除以 3，得 3x²/3 - 6x/3 + 9/3 = x² - 2x + 3。
questions.explanationRich: 將多項式每一項都除以 3，得 $\frac{3x²}{3}$ - $\frac{6x}{3}$ + $\frac{9}{3}$ = x² - 2x + 3。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 展開並化簡 (x + 2)(x + 3) - (x + 1)(x + 4)，結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是 x² - 16 的因式分解？
questions.explanation: x² - 16 = x² - 4² 是平方差的形式，利用平方差公式得 (x + 4)(x - 4)。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列何者是 4x² - 12x + 9 的因式分解？
questions.explanation: 4x² - 12x + 9 = (2x)² - 2×(2x)×3 + 3²，符合完全平方公式 (a - b)² 的形式，因此等於 (2x - 3)²。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 a - b = 4，ab = 5，則 a² + b² - 3ab 的值為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列多項式中，哪一個是完全平方式？
questions.explanation: x² - 6x + 9 = (x - 3)²，符合完全平方式的條件；其他選項均無法寫成 (x ± a)² 的形式。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 (x + y)² - (x - y)² 化簡後的結果為何？
questions.explanation: (x + y)² = x² + 2xy + y²；(x - y)² = x² - 2xy + y²；兩式相減得 4xy。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 將 (x + 3)² + 2(x + 3) - 8 完全因式分解，結果為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個展開式是正確的？
questions.explanation: (x + 1)(x - 1) = x² - 1² = x² - 1，符合平方差公式；其他選項均少計算了中間項或常數平方。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 多項式 x² + kx + 25 為完全平方式，則 k 的值可能為何？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 計算 (x + 2y)(x - 2y) - (x - y)² 化簡後的結果為何？
questions.explanation: (x + 2y)(x - 2y) = x² - 4y²；(x - y)² = x² - 2xy + y²；兩式相減得 (x² - 4y²) - (x² - 2xy + y²) = 2xy - 5y²。

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 下列哪一個數是有理數？
questions.explanation: √9 = 3，是整數，屬於有理數。其餘 √2、√5、√7 均為無理數。
questions.explanationRich: $\sqrt{9}$ = 3，是整數，屬於有理數。其餘 $\sqrt{2}$、$\sqrt{5}$、$\sqrt{7}$ 均為無理數。

questions.stem: √48 化簡後等於多少？

questions.subject: 數學
questions.stem: 若 x² = 25，則 x 的值為何？
questions.explanation: x² = 25 表示 x 的平方等於 25，5² = 25 且 (-5)² = 25，正負值皆可，故 x = 5 或 x = -5。負數的平方也是正數，不能捨去；12.5 是 25 的一半而非平方根，25 的平方則是 625。
